meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's zero. Who decided it, and why wasn't I called first?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Go on.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing down 11:52 and 11:58. He could have drafted it somewhere else and pasted it in. Did anyone ask him that before the zero?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Okay. Is anything on his record right now? Whatever happens here, it stays off his record and it stays quiet.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Students misquote Shakespeare from memory all the time. You still haven't answered me: is anything on his record right now?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. What else do you have? And whatever you tell me about his record, I'll want it in an email.
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and an essay all the time. That's called revising.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Okay. He'll sit the rewrite to put this behind him, not because he did anything. I want it in writing tonight, with nothing on his file, and my other questions go in my email.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth works. Put the time and the room in the email tonight, and I'll tell Owen myself.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite for Owen on Thursday the twelfth after school, its mark replacing the zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still want the time and room confirmed, and an answer on why the zero was entered before anyone called me and whether anything is on his record now. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to the private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, and she still wants it all in writing tonight plus an answer on whether anything is on his record now; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You showed the version history with its dates and times and told her to check it herself, which gave her something concrete to verify and softened her from demanding to asking.
What cost ground: You never answered her question about whether anything was on his record, which she asked twice and which kept her pressing for writing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came close, since it put the writing at 11:52 and 11:58 PM on the night before the essay was due, but it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said revising an outline is normal, answer that with something she could check, such as his notes or earlier drafts, before moving on to the offer.
